title: Crowd Crush — Passengers Sent to “Gate C4”

lines.text: Ops, this is Security 4. We have a crowd crush at the B10 hold room. The old FIDS data sent HW 2401 and SX 666 to Gate C4, and Gate C4 does not exist, so both crowds ended up at the end of Concourse B. Passengers are shoving, fighting over seats, and there’s a child down. We need help now.
Copy, Security 4. Police are on the way to B10. Hold position and keep people back from the jet bridge door. A supervisor is coming to you.
Roger. We're trying to keep people back from the gate, but the doors are jammed. We're going to need a med team on standby.

fields.voiceStyle: Young female, urgent, voice shaking slightly
